author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: সঠিক punctuation ও capital letter দিয়ে বাক্যটি আবার লেখো (কঠিন)।

items.original: the teacher said to the boys why are you making a noise
a: The teacher said to the boys, "Why are you making a noise?"
items.rule_bn: উক্তির আগে কমা, inverted comma, ভেতরে প্রশ্নবোধক (?)।

items.original: nazrul our national poet wrote the poem bidrohi
a: Nazrul, our national poet, wrote the poem 'Bidrohi'.
items.rule_bn: Apposition কমা দিয়ে; কবিতার নাম inverted comma-তে; নাম capital।

items.original: alas the poor man has lost everything he had
a: Alas! The poor man has lost everything he had.

items.original: he asked me whether i had read the book he had given me
a: He asked me whether I had read the book he had given me.
items.rule_bn: পরোক্ষ প্রশ্ন, তাই full stop; 'I' capital।

items.original: my brothers friend mr rahman is a lawyer
a: My brother's friend, Mr. Rahman, is a lawyer.
My brother's friend Mr Rahman is a lawyer.
items.rule_bn: মালিকানায় apostrophe; নাম/সংক্ষিপ্তরূপ capital; apposition কমা।

items.original: hurry up otherwise you will be late he said
a: "Hurry up, otherwise you will be late," he said.
items.rule_bn: উক্তি আগে থাকলে inverted comma-র ভেতরে কমা দিয়ে শেষ, তারপর he said।

items.original: we visited dhaka chittagong and sylhet last year
a: We visited Dhaka, Chittagong and Sylhet last year.

items.original: what an idea it is lets try it
a: What an idea it is! Let's try it.
